Method of Attack: Installed on hacked sites to exploit vulnerabilities in Adobe Flash Player (CVE-2018-4878) and Windows VBScript engine (CVE-2018-8174)
Downloads and installs malware including SmokeLoader and CoalaBot
Redirects macOS users to fake antivirus software or fake Adobe Flash Player pages
Trojan checks for specific processes to avoid detection and then downloads and executes DLL to install ransomware
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in Adobe Flash Player and Windows VBScript engine
Hacked websites hosting the exploit kit
Shellcode executing Nullsoft Installer self-extracting archive
Indicators of Compromise: Downloaded malware: SmokeLoader, CoalaBot, GandCrab ransomware
Ransomware appends .KRAB extension to encrypted files
Processes checked by Trojan: vmwareuser.exe, vmwareservice.exe, vboxservice.exe, vboxtray.exe, Sandboxiedcomlaunch.exe, procmon.exe, regmon.exe, filemon.exe, wireshark.exe, netmon.exe, vmtoolsd.exe
